page.layout: One printed title page, one block. Top: the title in display type, with a rule-bordered frame. Middle: "The Second Part.", "CONTAINING", and a descriptive paragraph in roman type. Lower: "By R. G.". Below that, a typographic ornament. Foot: the imprint in two lines.

main_text.l: The manifold Subtilties and Stratagems of Satan, for
the corrupting of the minds of Men with Errour;
and for the destruction of the Peace and Comfort
London, Printed by J. D. for Richard Randel, and Peter Maplisden,

page.notes: The ornament between "By R. G." and the imprint is a typographic fleuron (a block of stylised flower-like units in four rows of ornaments), with no text. Black-letter display words: "Satans" and "Temptations" in the second title line, with a large initial S and T. The first line uses small capitals with italic letters. Rules frame the title block. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and the dark binding shadow, which are not transcribed.
